note: _erat autem hora tertia et crucifixerunt eum_ – it was the third hour _when_ they crucified him. – Kaulen, p. 296 (modificative Sätze – “statements of modification”).

_ut quid dereliquisti me_? – what for did you forsake me? – The usual rendering “why have you (…)” does not do full justice to the Latin wording. – Hans Förster: Von Gott verlassen – warum oder zu welchem Zweck? In: Schmid/Fieger, pp. 113–114.
